up: Retrieve a list of all approved drugs that have a mechanism of action classified as a 'partial agonist'. For each drug, return its preferred name (pref_name), ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), the preferred name of the protein target (target_pref_name), and the ChEMBL ID of the protein target (target_chembl_id). An approved drug is defined as a molecule with max_phase = 4.
sql:
SELECT
  md.pref_name,
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id
FROM drug_mechanism dm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  dm.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST'
  AND md.max_phase = 4;
